name: Discord Activity
description: Shows live agent and tool activity as a Discord message that is updated and deleted when the agent finishes.

maxToolHistoryLength.description: Maximum number of tool calls to keep in history

maxStatusMessageLength.description: Maximum length of Discord status message content, capped at 1700 characters

orphanTtlSeconds.description: Time in seconds before orphaned tool calls are pruned

maxDisplaySeconds.description: Maximum idle time in seconds after status activity before automatic cleanup

replyMode.description: Whether status messages reply to all source messages when available or only in canonical private-message sessions; channel and group statuses remain standalone

decisionModel.description: TypeSafe Jev fallback for message reactions when OpenClaw has no selected decision model. An explicit empty agent decisionModel bypasses the global model and selects this fallback, if configured.

baseUrl.description: TypeSafe API root; omit to use the SDK default. A trailing /v1 is accepted.

apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key or environment SecretRef.

model.description: TypeSafe model ID, for example jev-latest.

skillLearnedNotice.description: Settings for the LLM-written background skill-review notice

model.description: Model ref (provider/model) that writes the learned-skill notice; omit to fall back to the notice agent's explicit utilityModel, then the host's default model (not necessarily the notice agent's own). A resolved model requires plugins.entries.discord-activity.llm.allowModelOverride

thinking.description: Requested thinking level for the notice rewrite; defaults to medium, including when the skillLearnedNotice section is omitted. The host and provider may map or clamp the request to what the selected model supports (for example down to off), without an error. Only an actual completion failure logs a warning and sends the original notice

promptAppend.description: Extra instructions appended to the notice system prompt, for example the language of the message

messageReaction.description: Jev-selected reaction on incoming Discord messages, using the same context filters as status cards

enabled.description: Enable semantic reactions; enabled by default

promptAppend.description: Extra instructions appended to the built-in reaction decision prompt

emojis.description: Candidate Unicode emoji. Omit for the built-in seven-category PiliApp snapshot; [] disables reactions; a nonempty list replaces the snapshot. Emoji applied to the previous 10 messages in the same conversation are left out, then up to 10 distinct emoji are sampled.
